evidence: brain_scout_schedule_* (crates/susi-gemi/src/tests/brain_scout_schedule.rs — 6 tests: leader change and provider death are reported drift, identical runs report none, the journal keeps every previous ranking as one JSON line per run and the diff against an earlier run reproduces the recorded drift, the cadence is bounded and env-overridable, production-wiring scan). `run_scheduled` production-reached from the daemon maintenance tick (crates/susi-daemon/src/runtime_admin.rs — the brain_scout subject goes through the shared probe scheduler's decide/record_run, so the sweep is cadence-gated, jittered, budgeted and offline-aware like every other scheduled probe).
missing: Scheduled scouting is now production-wired (T-DEEPSEEK-107): Maintenance::tick carries a `brain_scout` subject on the shared ProbeScheduler (interval + deterministic jitter + budget, default 6h via SUSI_BRAIN_SCOUT_INTERVAL_SECS); each run probes every registered provider through the same registry and key arbiter as dispatch (scout_probe::probe_registered, T-DEEPSEEK-99), records verified outcomes into the brain evidence store, snapshots the fit leader per task class, diffs against the journal's last run, and appends the run to ~/.susi/brain_scout_runs.jsonl — the previous ranking kept as evidence, not memory. Drift is reported two ways: LeaderChanged when a task class's leader differs from the last run, ProviderDied when a provider that answered before now fails every transport (a dead key/expired quota) — each event appended to the daemon's drift-alerts.jsonl and warned. The ranking core itself was delivered earlier (T-DEEPSEEK-98: cost per verified outcome, floor before price, unfit never leads) and the deterministic probe set (T-DEEPSEEK-99). What remains undelivered: catalogue-diff discovery — the sweep probes whatever is registered, but nothing snapshots each provider's catalogue, diffs new/retired models since the last scout, or re-triggers ranking on a catalogue event (price/context changes, a model appearing that could outrank the incumbent).
